end.summary:
- Practised representing 11–20 as one ten and some ones.
- Saanvi identified that a bundle contains ten, but repeatedly counted the bundle as one object.
- With prompting, Saanvi said “one ten and some ones” for fourteen.
- Teach-back was not completed; lesson ended when Saanvi asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised seeing a bundle as ten and adding loose ones, using fourteen and thirteen as examples. They reached “one ten and some ones” with prompting, but mixed up the bundle’s value with the number of bundles, and this was not fully corrected before the lesson ended. At home, make one group of 10 objects and a few single objects, then ask, “How many altogether?” while saying, “The group is ten; each loose one is one.”
